en: A vintage postcard-style image showing a rocky, tree-covered shoreline beside a wide lake. On the right, on top of a metal framework, stands a cylindrical water tower or tank. The scene looks across the lake toward low, forested land on the far side. The card has printed captions in red text: one at the bottom left reading "Lahti" and another at the bottom right reading "Sükkasalmi." Along the left edge, in smaller vertical print, appears a publisher line including the words "Athan Ensti, Lahti." The image has a lightly tinted, hand‑colored appearance.
